headline: A French TV host knocked two boxing humanoid robots to the studio floor and the clips went viral.
score_reason: Viral entertainment clip with no wider consequence; details such as the robot maker are unstated.
importance_line: Nothing changes for anyone beyond a laugh, but the clip shows viewers how easily today's humanoid robots lose their balance; the robots' maker and the segment date are not reported.
summary: Distractify reports that Cyril Hanouna, host of the French show Tout Beau Tout Neuf, boxed two humanoid robots called Bob and Leo in a two-against-one bout and sent both crashing to the floor with kicks and right hands before the bell. Clips are spreading across Instagram, where users joke the machines "will come after him first when they take over"; the site does not say who built the robots or when the segment aired.
notes: Entertainment outlet; robot maker and air date unstated.
